findings: [CONDITION-1: Mixed-route argument-group validation ordering in `commands/intent.rs` vs `commands/verify_intent.rs`] `DESIGN.md` lines 103, 120, and 163 specify that `intent` and `verify-intent` must preserve existing argument-only conflict and group validation ahead of the `mori::command::native-unavailable` error, and `DESIGN.md` line 103 proposes to native-gate `fn signed` and replace it with a no-native `signed` stub returning unavailable before file reads. In `source/crates/mori/src/commands/verify_intent.rs:43-56`, the missing-companion check `(Some(_), None) => Err("--profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 requires --target")` executes inside `run` *before* calling `signed(&args, target)`. In `source/crates/mori/src/commands/intent.rs:63-70, 164-170`, however, `run` checks only legacy flag conflicts (`lines 64-68`) before calling `signed(args, shell)`, while the companion argument check `let (Some(target), Some(at)) = (&args.target, args.at) else { return Err("--profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1 requires --target and --at together"); };` lives *inside* `fn signed` (`lines 165-169`). Condition for source preparation: authors must either hoist the `(Some(target), Some(at))` check into `intent::run` before calling `signed` or retain that pure argument check at the top of the no-native `signed` function before returning `native_unavailable()`, so `mori intent --profile moriarty-jubjub-owner-intent/1` without both `--target` and `--at` continues to report the argument-group error rather than `native-unavailable`.

[CONDITION-2: `commands/inspect.rs` `core1_refusal()` and Core/2 `--target` branch reachability under `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`] `DESIGN.md` line 101 proposes gating `inspect_target`, `core1_refusal`, `statement_rule`, `expression_constraints`, and `target_error` under `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`, while returning `mori::command::native-unavailable` before reading `args.file` whenever `args.target.is_some()` in a `--no-default-features` build. In `source/crates/mori/src/commands/inspect.rs:39-49`, after `read_source(&args.file)` and `mori_core::check_source_in_directory`, the `LanguageProfile::Core2` branch checks `if args.target.is_some() { return Err(core1_refusal()); }` (`line 46`). If `core1_refusal()` (`lines 286-293`) is gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]` without also gating the `if args.target.is_some()` block at `lines 45-47` (or `lines 39-49`), `--no-default-features` compilation will fail with an unresolved `core1_refusal` symbol (and under no-native, `args.target.is_some()` is already rejected before `read_source` at `line 19`, making `lines 45-47` unreachable when `not(feature = "native")`). Condition for source preparation: gate the post-check `--target` branch in `inspect.rs` consistently with `core1_refusal()` under `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`, and keep the pre-`read_source` `#[cfg(not(feature = "native"))] if args.target.is_some() { return Err(super::native_unavailable()); }` check at the top of `inspect::run`.

[CONDITION-3: Complete `#[cfg(feature = "native")]` dead-code and unused-import closures under `-D warnings`] Workspace lint policy (`source/Cargo.toml:27-37` and `DESIGN.md` lines 134-135) enforces `cargo clippy ... -- -D warnings`. Inspecting the exact source files shows multiple helper functions, constants, and imports that become unused when `native` is disabled if only the primary entrypoints listed in `DESIGN.md` lines 95-105 are gated: (a) `source/crates/mori/src/commands/compile_call.rs`: `fn validate_shape` (`lines 84-119`) is pure argument validation called only by `compile_call::run` (`line 50`); if no-native `compile_call::run` forwards directly to `native_unavailable()` as `DESIGN.md` line 95 specifies, `validate_shape` (plus `use super::{call_io, core_io, proof_io};` and `use std::{path::Path, process::ExitCode};`) must also be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (b) `source/crates/mori/src/commands/prepare_call.rs`: `fn binary` (`lines 92-104`), `fn publish_leaves` (`lines 106-119`), `use std::io::Read;`, and `use super::{call_io, core_io, proof_io};` must be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (c) `source/crates/mori/src/commands/compile.rs`: `use super::core_io;` must be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (d) `source/crates/mori/src/commands/proof_io.rs`: when only `pub struct Output` (`lines 12-18`) remains unconditional, top-level imports `use super::core_io;`, `use crate::error::CliError;`, `File`, `OpenOptions`, `ErrorKind`, `Write`, `Path`, `AtomicU64`, and `Ordering` (`lines 1-9`) must be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (e) `source/crates/mori/src/commands/call_io.rs` and `signed_call_io.rs`: when only `pub struct Input` remains unconditional, all non-Clap imports (`core_io`, `proof_io`, `call_io`, `CliError`, `Shell`, `Path`, `ExitCode`, `mori_ledger::*`) must be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (f) `source/crates/mori/tests/core_continuations.rs`: gating the 5 native-dependent tests (`lines 313, 381, 419, 444, 513`) also requires gating `const SIGNED_TARGET` (`lines 496-510`) and ensuring `fn diagnostic` (`lines 366-379`) is either called by the new no-native availability test or gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]`; (g) `source/crates/mori/tests/fee_pool_component.rs`: `fn status_text` (`lines 72-78`) is called exclusively inside the native test `public_source_static_all_actions_and_separate_process_reopen_both_programs` (`lines 479, 498, 499`) and must also be gated `#[cfg(feature = "native")]` alongside `fn static_command` (`lines 436-464`).

[CONDITION-4: Incomplete external-fixture and `#[path]` inventory in `DESIGN.md` vs `source/RUST_GUIDELINES.md`] `DESIGN.md` line 155 identifies only `stage_test_public.rs` (`../../models/core-stage-tests`) and `core_continuations.rs` (`../../../examples/...`) as conflicting with `source/RUST_GUIDELINES.md:53` ("Nothing under `crates/` reads outside it"). Direct inspection of all 20 integration test files in `source/crates/mori/tests/` shows that two additional Core/mixed test files in the `--no-default-features` test matrix also read outside `crates/` at runtime: `source/crates/mori/tests/core_test_report.rs:198-205` (`../../examples/core/fee-pool`) and `source/crates/mori/tests/fee_pool_component.rs:11-16, 713` (`../../examples/core/fee-pool` and `examples/core/static-compile/signer-policy.json`), in addition to native test files (`check_compile_io.rs:16`, `check_static_compile_io.rs:19`, `mapped_role_static_io.rs:19`, `native_proofs.rs:51`, `signed_intents.rs:52`, `replay.rs:25,30`, `enforcement_report.rs:27`). Furthermore, `source/crates/mori/tests/prepare_call.rs:3`, `installed_call.rs:25`, and `signed_installed_call.rs:53` use `#[path = "../../mori-ledger/tests/support/mod.rs"] mod support;`, which conflicts with `source/RUST_GUIDELINES.md:52` ("no `#[path]` mounts a file from another directory"). Condition for source preparation: the explicit guideline disposition/exception must record the full set of existing cross-directory fixture reads (including `core_test_report.rs` and `fee_pool_component.rs`) and pre-existing test `#[path]` mounts, while still prohibiting any new `#[path]` mounts or fixture relocations in this boundary change.

[CONDITION-5: Prefer `[[test]] required-features = ["native"]` in `crates/mori/Cargo.toml` for the 11 native-only integration test targets] `DESIGN.md` line 151 allows gating the 11 native-only test files (`check_compile_io`, `check_static_compile_io`, `prepare_call`, `installed_call`, `signed_installed_call`, `native_proofs`, `signed_intents`, `replay`, `replay_challenge`, `enforcement_report`, `mapped_role_static_io`) either via `[[test]] required-features = ["native"]` in `source/crates/mori/Cargo.toml` or via crate-root `#![cfg(feature = "native")]`. Condition for source preparation: use `[[test]] name = "..." required-features = ["native"]` in `crates/mori/Cargo.toml` consistently across all 11 targets. Unlike `#![cfg(feature = "native")]` (which compiles an empty test binary and reports `0 passed` during unfiltered `--no-default-features` test runs), `required-features = ["native"]` makes Cargo skip building those targets unless `native` is enabled, directly enforcing `DESIGN.md` line 151's requirement not to claim skipped no-default cases passed and allowing `cargo test -p mori --no-default-features` to run cleanly without enumerating `--test` flags. Also note explicitly that `check_compile_io.rs` contains both `mori check` (`lines 118-297, 665-688`) and `mori compile` (`lines 298-663, 690-700`) tests; keeping the whole target `required-features = ["native"]` in this cut and deferring test-file splitting is appropriate.

[ASSESSMENT: Smallest coherent dependency boundary and Cargo feature closure] The proposed `crates/mori/Cargo.toml` boundary (`default = ["native"]`, with `native` enabling `dep:mori-backend`, `dep:mori-ledger`, `dep:futures`, `dep:rand`, and the 8 Midnight crates moved from unconditional `[dev-dependencies]` to `optional = true` normal `[dependencies]`) is verified against the workspace manifests (`source/Cargo.toml`, `source/crates/mori/Cargo.toml`, `source/crates/mori-core/Cargo.toml`, `source/crates/mori-backend/Cargo.toml`, `source/crates/mori-ledger/Cargo.toml`). Because Cargo does not support optional `dev-dependencies`, moving the 8 Midnight crates to optional `[dependencies]` under `native` is necessary and minimal so that `cargo test -p mori --no-default-features` does not resolve or link Midnight crates, while `mori` binary code in `src/` never imports `midnight_*` directly. Unconditional `k256` in `mori-core` (`source/crates/mori-core/src/intent.rs:4-8, 326-447`) is confirmed required for legacy `SchnorrBip340` and `EcdsaSecp256k1Sha256` intent verification and simulation (`mori intent`, `mori verify-intent`, `mori simulate --intent`) and is not part of the Midnight SDK closure.

[ASSESSMENT: Preservation of CLI discoverability, default semantics, refusal codes, and no-fallback invariants] Retaining full Clap schemas in `cli.rs`, `call_io::Input`, `signed_call_io::Input`, and `proof_io::Output` while gating execution behind `native` preserves `--help` / `-V` discoverability, argument conflict/requirement validation, and default-build behavior (`cargo build`, `cargo run -p mori -- ...`). Returning `CliError::with_code("mori::command::native-unavailable", ...)` (`ExitCode::from(2)`, JSON `"code": "mori::command::native-unavailable"`) before any target, deployment, proof, key, witness, source, or scenario file I/O when `native` is disabled prevents silent fallback (`simulate --trace` never falls back to untargeted simulation; `inspect --target` never falls back to source-only inspection; `intent --profile` / `verify-intent --profile` never fall back to legacy secp256k1; `test` continues to reject `moriarty-core/1` and `moriarty-core/2` test manifests without invoking native compilation).

[ASSESSMENT: Preserved operational caveats, oracle limits, and open parent-issue / security boundaries] The design appropriately preserves: (a) immutable `Cargo.lock` and git-source metadata reality (`source/Cargo.toml:14-21` retains `[patch."https://github.com/midnightntwrk/midnight-zk"]`, so `--no-default-features` removes Midnight crates from the `-p mori` build graph without claiming a fresh git-free `Cargo.lock` regeneration); (b) the 5-command build/test matrix (`--no-default-features`, default `-p mori`, `--features native`, workspace default, and `--all-features`); (c) existing R3 stage-test public-boundary oracle blinding limits (`source/crates/mori/src/commands/test/stage_test.rs`) and shared-evaluator Logical Meter limits (`source/crates/mori/tests/logical_meter.rs`); (d) explicit referral of the security-relevant error-precedence and no-partial-output questions (`DESIGN.md` lines 162-167) to the designated security owner; and (e) open status for parent Issue #81 and all compiler/proof/ledger/financial roadmap gates (U0-U7, M1-M17, MC01-MC08, SP01-SP12, G01-G24, ACTUS, DeFi).
